artworks.title: Violinist
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body illustrations of a person playing a violin in different positions. The individual has short wavy hair and wears a feathered hat. They are dressed in historical attire, including a puffed sleeve shirt, a waistcoat, knee-length drawers, stockings, and shoes with bows, as well as a cape. The individual is holding a violin on their shoulder with one hand and a bow with the other, positioned as if playing. The background is a plain, lightly textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Peasant with Hat in Hand
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.9 × 8.6 cm (2 5/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two similar male figures drawn in profile, positioned side by side and facing right. Both figures are shown in a walking stance, with one leg slightly bent in front. The figures have bearded faces with an aged appearance, and their heads are slightly bald. They are dressed in loose-fitting clothes and jackets, with one figure's jacket having vertical lines indicating draped fabric. Both figures hold a hat in one hand, suggesting a motion with the free hand extended slightly ahead. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Man Wrapped in His Mantle
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body views of a person facing away from the viewer. The individual stands with feet slightly apart and wears a wide-brimmed hat with feathers on top, along with curly hair peeking out. They are draped in a cloak with fur trim, and wear breeches tied below the knee, stockings, and pointed shoes. The person appears to be holding a cane or a stick in both images. The background is minimal, emphasizing the line drawing.

artworks.title: Gentleman with Cane
artworks.description: The image features two full-length figures seen from behind, both in dynamic stances. They are turned slightly sideways, with subtly depicted facial features, wearing hats with large feathers. Their attire includes cloaks, billowing trousers, gloves, canes, and swords. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Man with Sword
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fanciful figures with exaggerated features. The figures are depicted in dynamic postures, wearing extravagant costumes. They stand on one leg with raised arms, facing away from the viewer. The figures are embellished with elaborate headwear and draped clothing. The artist uses simple, clean lines with minimal shading to define the contours and folds of their garments.

artworks.title: Man seen from Behind with His Right Arm Extended
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures viewed from behind. Each figure is extending an arm outwards, with their other arm by their side, and both are facing away from the viewer. The figures have similar posture and attire. Their visible facial features are minimal due to the angle, but they appear to have curly hair topped by a hat with an extravagant plume or feather. The clothing includes a long cloak draped over the shoulder, a jacket with full sleeves, and baggy knee-length pants, secured with cords or ties around the legs. A sword hangs from a belt at the waist of each figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Two Women in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing and facing each other. On the left is a woman wearing a dress with a fitted bodice and a long, flowing skirt. She has a feathered hat atop her head. On the right is a man wearing a long coat or cloak and a brimmed hat. He is holding a cane or stick. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.description: The image displays two full-length profiles of a person posing in different stances on each side. The individual is gazing towards the viewer with distinct facial features, including a notable nose and chin. They wear a broad-brimmed hat and layered clothing with a draped collar. One side is detailed with visible garment pleats, while the other is a simple outline. The background is plain, with no visible accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Front View
artworks.description: The etching features two full-body images of a person in different poses, standing confidently. Both figures show a slight lean, suggesting movement or balance. The facial features are sketched with an exaggerated style, with prominent noses, elaborate smiles, and wild, curly hair. The figures wear similar outfits consisting of breeches, a cloak, and headdresses adorned with feathers. They both hold a long sword behind them with one hand. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures' attire and posture.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image shows two depictions of a person drawn from behind, capturing their full-length body. The person is standing with legs slightly apart, wearing attire typical of a certain historical period. They have medium-length, wavy hair partially covered by a plumed hat. The person is wearing a large, draped cape or cloak over loose-fitting trousers tied at the knees with bows. One figure carries an umbrella or walking stick. The background of the image is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Front with Hand on Hip
artworks.description: The image features two full-length figures standing side by side. They are depicted in a similar posture, each with one hand on their hip and the other arm draped casually. Both figures wear wide-brimmed hats with plumes. Their facial features are simple, with sparse lines indicating their expressions. Their hair flows loosely from under their hats. Both figures wear breeches, draped outer garments resembling cloaks, and shirts with visible cuffs. The texture and shadowing indicate layers of fabric and subtle shading variations. The background is plain, emphasizing the two figures in the image.

artworks.title: Peasant with a Cup
artworks.description: The image shows two figures depicted from the back in a slight contrapposto pose. Both figures wear wide-brimmed hats and long tunics or jackets tied at the waist, along with trousers and boots. Each figure holds a long, slender object in one hand and a cup in the other. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Side
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a person twice, in two slightly different positions. The figure is shown in a dynamic walking posture, with one foot slightly ahead and shoulders turned. Their head is tilted to the side, and they have a hat adorned with a feather, partially obscuring their facial features. The hair appears curled at the sides, and the face is captured in profile. They are wearing a fur-lined cloak over their shoulders, which drapes over the body and down the back. Their clothing includes knee-length trousers with horizontal stripes for the left figure and plain breeches for the right figure, neither figure wears shoes with decorative bows. A sword hilt is visible around the waist at the back. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Peasant with Shovel on His Shoulder
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing to the right, looking toward a vast open space. The person is holding a staff or stick with a shovel resting over one shoulder. The horizon is low with hills, buildings, and trees visible in the distance. The style features fine, detailed lines typical of etching techniques. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and beige tones creating contrast. Details are more pronounced in the foreground and become more delicate towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaged in a fencing match. The image depicts two figures facing each other, holding swords and dressed in period clothing. The figures are in a dynamic pose, with one raising a sword overhead and gripping their opponent's hand, while the other is in a defensive posture. The scene is set on a simple, lightly sketched ground. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching techniques to show depth and texture, common in early European sketches of combat or sports.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords and Daggers
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two individuals in a sword duel. The scene shows them engaged in combat, with one figure stepping forward and the other leaning back defensively. Both are dressed in historical attire, holding swords and locked in battle. The costumes feature doublets with puffed sleeves and gathered trousers common in Renaissance or Baroque fashion. The detailed linework highlights the motion and tension of the duel.

artworks.title: Peasant Attacked by Bees
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing outdoors. He is leaning forward slightly and raising his left hand while holding a walking stick in his right hand. The man wears a cap with a feather, a long robe with striped pants, and shoes. A small dog stands on its hind legs near him. The background includes rolling hills, distant figures, a building against a hill, and a tree with elaborate branches. The scene is sketched with fine lines, depicting a natural setting with trees, hills, and possibly farm animals.

artworks.title: Peasant Removing His Shoe
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated to the right leaning against a tree, with a donkey standing to the left. The background includes distant buildings and hills sketched with fine lines. The tree branches frame the right side, with detailed engravings for texture on the leaves and bark. The style is characterized by clear, precise lines typical of an etching. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the contrast between dark lines and a light background. Softly etched details are seen in the distance, contrasting with bolder lines near the man and donkey.

artworks.title: Peasant with Sack
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing sideways in a natural landscape. He is facing right, holding a walking stick in his left hand and a bag in his right hand. The man has a long, bushy beard and a somewhat somber expression. He is wearing a brimmed hat, a long coat with a broad collar, and flowing clothing. The background includes rocky terrain with sparse vegetation. A small dog is seen on a ledge behind him. The trees and ground are illustrated with fine line work.

artworks.title: Peasant Defecating
artworks.description: The image shows a crouching figure on the left side of the frame. The person is in a squatting pose, with their upper body bent forward and their arms close to their legs. They have a serious expression, wear a broad-brimmed hat, and loose, heavy clothing. They are near a tree with thick foliage. In the background, there is a small stream or body of water with sparse vegetation. To the right of the figure, there is a horse or similar animal from the rear, possibly grazing. A basic rope fence is visible near the animal. The background depicts a wooded area with vertical lines.

artworks.title: Dancers with Flute and Tambourine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures playing musical instruments. The image shows two characters in lively attire, both wearing ruffled garments and headgear with feathers. One figure is playing a tambourine with one leg raised, while the other is playing a woodwind instrument. Both figures exhibit expressions of concentration and engagement with their music. The line work in the drawing is intricate, with detailed shading and texture that conveys the dynamics and energy of a musical performance. The composition and style suggest influences from 16th or 17th-century European art, with an emphasis on movement and expression.

artworks.title: Dancers with Lute
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two grotesque figures in an exaggerated and whimsical style. One figure on the left is adorned in bulky, oversized clothing with a peculiar facial expression, featuring large eyes and an exaggerated facial structure. The second figure on the right wields a long-necked string instrument, wearing similarly exaggerated attire and a fantastical helmet or hat with large round glasses. The scene conveys a theatrical or playful interaction between the two figures, creating a comedic and surreal atmosphere. The crisp line work accentuates the exaggerated features and costumes of the figures, making it a visually engaging composition.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: The image features two figures with distorted and elongated limbs in dynamic poses. The composition evokes creatures or jesters in motion, with exaggerated features and flowing clothing resembling puppet marionettes or animated costumes. Delicate, intricate lines create depth and tension in the background.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two grotesque figures facing each other. Two humanoid figures with exaggerated, bestial features stand facing each other. They each have long, pointed noses and a set of horns atop their heads, with exaggerated expressions on their faces. Their bodies are elongated and distorted, with muscular details. They each wear garments that cling to their form and share a similar design. The scene is constricted within a narrow rectangular frame. Lines below their feet likely indicate the ground.
